domains.entry: Open browser leaf / Open embedded browser
remaining: Explicit per-site permissions and registered-host browser handover
Real-owner HTTPS/QUIC, proxy permutations and positive IPv6 coverage

direct-ssh.check: Real SSH terminal input and detach; no display-local owner starts

local-sessions.check: Create, attach, switch, cancel, stop and delete; another window stays on the original generation

ssh-admission-and-jump.check: Connect a registered host from the UI and enable merge, optionally through two real ProxyJump hops on the isolated fixture

layout-history.check: Actual pane menus: move, swap, transpose, zoom, focus back and forward

workspace-lifecycle.check: Act on a background workspace by ID; cancel close, close the last workspace with unavailable HOME and reopen from empty

files.check: Expand, create a file/folder, filter, activate finder result, rename and delete; preserve replacement file on stale confirmation

terminal-ime.check: Real Chromium composition, no preedit in PTY, one exact Unicode commit; OSC 8 target and OSC 52 write

terminal-graphics.check: Real Kitty image in alternate screen; matching canvas pixels, deletion and restoration

terminal-selection.check: Physical drag and copy joins soft wraps while preserving indentation and wide glyphs; stale mouse and selection after resize both rejected

agent-native.check: Real adapter reads private native-format rollout fixture, resume/fork argv reach two PTYs, persisted token counts agree between owner and Mission Control

agent-recovery.check: Real isolated owner restart delays delivery until the same native session is ready; another session in the same cwd cannot rebind

mixed-clients.check: TUI, App and paired read-only Web run together. Private copy/scroll/resize stay display-local; session inbox notice reaches the TUI and App; Web cannot mutate

slow-display.check: Pause a real App stdio consumer during 200 forced paints. Foreground input still reaches its PTY and the resumed reader converges to the current frame

human-download.check: Physical guest input selects native Save options; fixture substitutes only the destination and verifies exact bytes, without writing into user Downloads

local-secure-network.check: Real IPv6 origin, untrusted TLS rejection, scoped pinned HTTPS with Alt-Svc, zero QUIC sessions and zero display UDP packets

active-automation.check: Busy skip, parked wait, event-driven delivery without a task or fake completion

commander-private.check: Two Electron displays maintain independent drafts

commander-receipts.check: Two instrumented agent PTYs; ready receives exactly one prompt, busy refuses and remains selected for retry; navigate fleet

orchestration.check: A real isolated Git worktree worker, explicit parent, completion, lease and worktree lists

github.check: Offline gh fixture through the real Git panel: PR list, details and checks, failures and missing client

module-widgets.check: A real isolated provider receives distinct row and bar action values, failure appears in its logs

diagnostics.check: Explicit read-only/control Web and UHP, actual loopback port and shutdown, log headers, positive and negative bounded wait

native-diff.check: Native Markdown/Mermaid, commit detail, positioned notes; stale edit preserves draft without overwriting another reviewer, split shows exact old/new lines

settings-modules.check: Persist a setting, read effective keys and themes, surface a refused module directory

settings-inventory.check: Every projected preference has a control; all nine language settings persist, integration cancel/install/uninstall and skill enable/disable touch only isolated profiles

browser-descendant.check: Control a cross-site child and reject unrelated target attachment and browser-wide shutdown

agent-browser.check: Pinned agent-browser connects via the scoped endpoint and snapshots, fills, clicks and captures the tab

registered-switch-recovery.check: One shared SSH display for A/B/A, reject old tickets and offline input, recover the same owner PTYs; verify both terminal outputs on the owner

terminal-input.check: Typed input returns from the real terminal frame

file-view.check: Opening a workspace file displays its contents in a native leaf

owner-files.check: Verify exact bytes both ways, reject escape and overwrite, cancel during transfer

owner-network.check: Owner proxy, localhost and WebSocket verified with the same-port display trap; zero display STUN packets or DNS-resolution events for the test name
